answer: A payout is split and therefore 37% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The kernel schedule is applied in island and tide shows each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4200 identities would post 547 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
